trial_court: Civil Judge Sr. Division, Kaithal (case number not mentioned)
case_name: Sumitar Kaur vs General Public And Another

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Sumi-tar Kaur, widow and legal heir
parties.respondent_defendant: Amar Kaur, widow and only legal heir

facts_of_case: Smt. Amar Kaur filed application for grant of succession certificate to her in respect of the estate of late Waryam Singh. Smt. Sumitar Kaur contested the grant of succession certificate exclusively to Smt. Amar Kaur, praying that succession certificates be granted to her and Amar Kaur in equal shares.

legal_principles.principle: A Hindu cannot take another wife during the subsistence of his previous marriage.
legal_principles.held: After the coming in force of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 during the subsistence of his previous marriage, a Hindu cannot take another wife.

legal_principles.principle: The status of wife can only be conferred on a person if they are found to be legally wedded wives.
legal_principles.held: The status of wife could be conferred on Sumitar Kaur if she is found to be legally wedded wife.

outcome.final_order: The court set aside the order of Additional District Judge, Kaithal dated 4.6.1999 and directed that grant of succession certificate to Amar Kaur and Sumitar Kaur respecting the estate of Waryam Singh in equal shares.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for succession certificate
